identificationSites.name: Marshall Pass D&RG / D&RGW Railroad & Toll Road Summit Complex
overview: Marshall Pass is a documented historic transportation summit associated with the Denver & Rio Grande railroad and an earlier toll-road corridor. Existing research supports the surviving grade and summit landscape as a basic Scan identity.

identificationSites.name: Orient Iron Mine & Orient Company Town Complex
overview: The Orient iron mine and its upper and lower company-town areas form a documented historic mining and settlement complex. Existing research supports the mine-and-town landscape as a basic Scan identity.
